He wants you.”", "sha256": "aaf32f0439c21d6c83125720803b36f2e3507d937a16909931c95867fa052d6e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[51]", "source_html": "

“It’s Mr. Bascom, sir. He wants you.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“Tell Mr. Bascom to go to hell,” said Francis, simulating so long a cast, that, had it been in verity a cast, and had it pursued the course his fascinated gaze indicated, it would have gone through the window and most likely startled the gardener outside kneeling over the rose bush he was planting.", "sha256": "6b03d79831e73e951b14ec3281f3e86e91ca48552239c6857d798930567d9767", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[52]", "source_html": "

“Tell Mr. Bascom to go to hell,” said Francis, simulating so long a cast, that, had it been in verity a cast, and had it pursued the course his fascinated gaze indicated, it would have gone through the window and most likely startled the gardener outside kneeling over the rose bush he was planting.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“Mr. Bascom says it’s about the market, sir, and that he’d like to talk with you only a moment,” Parker urged, but so delicately and subduedly as to seem to be merely repeating an immaterial and unnecessary message.", "sha256": "23410fecdcd641e5047819ad74941f65d2393d6ba1ade3ef678c64bd684f411f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[53]", "source_html": "

“Mr. Bascom says it’s about the market, sir, and that he’d like to talk with you only a moment,” Parker urged, but so delicately and subduedly as to seem to be merely repeating an immaterial and unnecessary message.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“All right.” Francis carefully leaned the rod against a table and went to the ‘phone.", "sha256": "b0a5a59d3bd28f6b1523ff5cf067bdc42f05797e9879050ad499a6d6af04d5b2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[54]", "source_html": "

“All right.” Francis carefully leaned the rod against a table and went to the ‘phone.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Hello,” he said into the telephone. “Yes, this is I, Morgan. Shoot, What is it?”", "sha256": "05926e243f47de790250ed79c93d99a709345514f4872d740e93c85cae083973", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[55]", "source_html": "

“Hello,” he said into the telephone. “Yes, this is I, Morgan. Shoot, What is it?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "He listened for a minute, then interrupted irritably: “Sell—hell. Nothing of the sort.... Of course, I’m glad to know. Even if it goes up ten points, which it won’t, hold on to everything. It may be a legitimate rise, and it mayn’t ever come down. It’s solid. It’s worth far more than it’s listed. I know, if the public doesn’t. A year from now it’ll list at two hundred ... that is, if Mexico can cut the revolution stuff.... Whenever it drops you’ll have buying orders from me.... Nonsense. Who wants control? It’s purely sporadic ... eh? I beg your pardon. I mean it’s merely temporary. Now I’m going off fishing for a fortnight. If it goes down five points, buy. Buy all that’s offered. Say, when a fellow’s got a real bona fide property, being bulled is almost as bad as having the bears after one ... yes.... Sure ... yes. Good-bye.”", "sha256": "64e06b048bb4dd9b3079710860fd39489fcf3697110a724a936a752e21818044", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[56]", "source_html": "

Having arranged with his various brokers to buy, and, through his divers channels of secret publicity having let slip the cryptic tip that something was wrong with Tampico Petroleum’s concessions from the Mexican government, Thomas Regan studied a report of his own oil-expert emissary who had spent two months on the spot spying out what Tampico Petroleum really had in sight and prospect.", "sha256": "6f3bf4e9945f9ca4c7bfdae49eb628ee8523e66e65fd244adcdccee060852546", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[57]", "source_html": "

A clerk brought in a card with the information that the visitor was importunate and foreign. Regan listened, glanced at the card, and said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0040", "tag": "p", "text": "“Tell this Mister Senor Alvarez Torres of Ciodad de Colon that I can’t see him.”", "sha256": "4ee9a64366b693ccd0e8d5b7c3cfda1100947651a1457caeb5fc48401401b14f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[59]", "source_html": "

“Tell this Mister Senor Alvarez Torres of Ciodad de Colon that I can’t see him.”

Regan grinned as he read it:", "sha256": "e22363693ab5dd307ed5175d65ce491189c7aefed7b94d2ae2455bf2ddf54993", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[60]", "source_html": "

Five minutes later the clerk was back, this time with a message pencilled on the card. Regan grinned as he read it:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0042", "tag": "display_group", "text": "“[[I]]Dear Mr. Regan[[/I]], “[[I]]Honoured Sir[[/I]]:—", "sha256": "558501a8ded1ce75f31c9b09b5169d0eff0744a201234054b2fd10ac008d55d4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[16]/div/div", "source_html": "
“Dear Mr. Regan,
“Honoured Sir:—
", "emphasis_spans": 2, "source_lines": ["“[[I]]Dear Mr. Regan[[/I]],", "“[[I]]Honoured Sir[[/I]]:—"], "linebreak_role": "AUTHENTIC_DOCUMENT_DISPLAY", "source_indentation_classes": ["line", "line in2"]}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“[[I]]I have the honour to inform you that I have a tip on the location of the treasure Sir Henry Morgan buried in old pirate days.[[/I]]", "sha256": "e959554a1e328434e8e30533d4dab6b2dcc1d49aab53bb56cab24a847eb046eb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[61]", "source_html": "

“Alvarez Torres.”

Regan shook his head, and the clerk was nearly out of the room when his employer suddenly recalled him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0046", "tag": "p", "text": "“Show him in—at once.”", "sha256": "0d7c89bcc3b4c86d9e0caf48219b1a4f335a50de52a316cfe70519ce979a6dfa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[63]", "source_html": "

“Show him in—at once.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u003-r0047", "tag": "p", "text": "In the interval of being alone, Regan chuckled to himself as he rolled the new idea over in his mind. “The unlicked cub!” he muttered through the smoke of the cigar he was lighting. “Thinks he can play the lion part old R.H.M. played.
